title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds a new set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, two language quickstarts (TypeScript and Python), a tool-calling example demonstrating a Google Sheets connector, and accompanying docs site updates. Motivation: provide curated, production-oriented examples that demonstrate best practices for RAG pipelines on Redwood: secure connector wiring, KV prefix caching recommendations, model selection guidance, and deterministic tool calling patterns. The PR includes: 1) RAG agent templates under redwood-examples/rag-templates (vector-store-backed retrieval with optional chunk overlap, metadata filters, and evaluation prompt hooks). 2) Two quickstarts: quickstarts/rag-quickstart-python and quickstarts/rag-quickstart-ts with step-by-step walkthroughs for ingestion, local dev, and deploying to Redwood Dedicated. 3) Tool-calling sample: examples/tool-calling/google-sheets-agent which shows how to implement an authenticated Google Sheets tool, idempotent updates, and safe sandboxing for user-provided formulas. 4) Docs site changes: docs/reference/rag.md, docs/quickstarts/index.md, docs/quickstarts/rag-quickstart.md, and updated sidebar config to surface the new quickstarts. 5) Tests and CI: unit tests for the Sheets connector, integration smoke test for the Python quickstart using the test harness, and docs build checks. Security/operational notes are included in the template README covering credentials (KMS/HSM suggestions), least-privilege scopes, and a recommended canary prompt set for regression monitoring. All description and code examples are written with developer ergonomics in mind and reference Linear tickets ENG-4821 and ENG-4898 for follow-up tracking.
